metadata.description: One opinionated process for delivering software - what was agreed, how it is built, and whether it has been proved - packaged so every team and every agent works the same way.

plugins.name: delivery-dev
plugins.description: How software gets built and repaired: the three test layers run as gates without being asked, the defect procedure that keeps a fix closed, and the handoffs that keep the BA, QA and Dev on one document.

plugins.name: delivery-ba
plugins.description: Business analysis: turning what a customer says into requirements that can be built and acceptance criteria that can be proved, sized honestly, with the scope line held.

plugins.name: delivery-qa
plugins.description: Quality assurance: deriving scenarios from acceptance criteria, keeping coverage honest, running a round, and proving it to the customer at UAT.

plugins.name: delivery-pm
plugins.description: Running the project: the plan, the money, the risks and the steering report - assembled from what the other three produce, so the numbers reported are the numbers that happened.

plugins.name: delivery-po
plugins.description: Owning the product or the scope: goal and value, what is in and out, what order, what the minimum is, and whether the result is accepted.

plugins.name: delivery-sa
plugins.description: Solution architecture: the shape it is built in, the interfaces it publishes, how the non-functional requirements are actually met, and the trade-offs behind each - written down where the next person will meet them.
